Remark
[Real analyticity in the noncompact case] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0252 ↗ lem:chow-ii-main-factorial-curvature-estimate ↗ lem:chow-ii-normal-coordinate-metric-derivatives 1. ch13:13.32\group Real Analyticity

For a complete noncompact bounded-curvature Ricci flow, Shi's local estimates give $t^k|\nabla ^k\Rm |^2\leq C_k$ on every initial compact time interval. These bounds justify the global weak maximum principle in the factorial estimate, so the same normal-coordinate argument proves spatial real analyticity at every positive time.
